Scope

The verification uses public indexer responses; it is not independent signature or consensus-proof validation. A report commitment does not establish report accuracy or anonymity. Its signer and transaction link are public.

The Sapient account needed an on-chain account component and 0.1 TARI of revealed balance for its preview, alongside private funds for the actual private-fee request. This is a tested setup requirement, not a guarantee that every wallet version behaves identically.
